Ansible Playbooks

标准答案

基本结构

---
- name: Deploy Web Application
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  vars:
    app_port: 8080
    
  tasks:
    - name: Install Nginx
      apt:
        name: nginx
        state: present
        
    - name: Copy configuration
      template:
        src: nginx.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
      notify: Restart Nginx
      
    - name: Start Nginx
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: yes
        
  handlers:
    - name: Restart Nginx
      service:
        name: nginx
        state: restarted
